title: Settings
generalText: VAT, delivery fees and days, company details on documents
usersText: Staff logins, roles, teams, per-person access
masterControlText: Who sees and does what (roles, permissions, hidden fields)
dataRequestsText: Copy or deletion requests (Data Privacy Act)
deleteRequestsText: Approve staff delete requests; open Trash
vatHelp: Decision D4 (ask the accountant): are prices VAT-inclusive, and is the discount taken before VAT? Changes apply to new orders only.
receiptFooterHint: Must say the delivery receipt is not a BIR invoice.
blockedDatesHelp: Holidays and other days with no delivery. Customers cannot choose these dates.
agentUsersHelp: Agent logins are created from the Agents page. Open a person to change their access.
portalUsersHelp: Customer logins come from sign-up or the Customers page. Open a person to change their access.
name: Name
tempPasswordHelp: Give these to the person. They must choose a new password at first login. Shown only once.
teamsHelp: Used for the “Own team” scope in Master Control.
deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this login? The person is signed out and cannot log in.
overridesHelp: Change access for this person only. Yellow rows differ from their role.
dataRequestsHelp: Copy: the person gets a file with their data. Deletion: their personal details are blanked; order totals stay for legal records.
deletionWarning: Approving blanks this person's name, contact and address and disables their login. This cannot be undone.
typeNameToDelete: Type the person's name to confirm
